description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Status of the gift. Possible values are : scheduled, unclaimed, claimed, cancelled, expired.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → status[is] = "claimed"

is.description: \* \`scheduled\` - Gift has been scheduled. \* \`unclaimed\` - Gift is not yet claimed and is ready to be claimed. \* \`claimed\` - Gift is claimed. \* \`cancelled\` - Gift is cancelled. \* \`expired\` - Gift is expired.

is_not.description: \* \`scheduled\` - Gift has been scheduled. \* \`unclaimed\` - Gift is not yet claimed and is ready to be claimed. \* \`claimed\` - Gift is claimed. \* \`cancelled\` - Gift is cancelled. \* \`expired\` - Gift is expired.
